## Cloud Dragon, Very Old (CR 17)

**XP** 102,400  
 CN Gargantuan dragon (air)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** dragon senses, mist vision; Perception +31; **Aura** frightful presence (270 ft., DC 26)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 33, touch 4, flat-footed 33 (–2 Dex, +29 natural, –4 size)  
**hp** 275 (22d12+132)  
**Fort** +19, **Ref** +11, **Will** +19  
 **DR** 15/magic; **Immune** electricity, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 28  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 250 ft. (clumsy), swim 40 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +29 (4d6+15/19-20), 2 claws +29 (2d8+10), tail slap +26 (2d8+15), 2 wings +26 (2d6+5)  
**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 15 ft. (20 ft. with bite)  
**Special Attacks** breath weapon (60-ft. cone, 18d8 electricity, DC 27), crush (4d6+15), tail sweep (2d6+15)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 22nd; concentration +27)  

 At will—*[fog cloud](../../magic/spells/fog-cloud.md)*, *[obscuring mist](../../magic/spells/obscuring-mist.md)*, *[solid fog](../../magic/spells/solid-fog.md)**  
*3/day—*[cloudkill](../../magic/spells/cloudkill.md)* (DC 20)  

 **Spells Known** (CL 11th; concentration +16)  

 5th (5/day)—*[cone of cold](../../magic/spells/cone-of-cold.md)* (DC 20), *[teleport](../../magic/spells/teleport.md)*  
4th (7/day)—*elemental body*, *[ice storm](../../magic/spells/ice-storm.md)*, *[river of wind](../../magic/spells/river-of-wind.md)**  
3rd (7/day)—*[arcane sight](../../magic/spells/arcane-sight.md)*, *[cloak of winds](../../magic/spells/cloak-of-winds.md)**, *[stinking cloud](../../magic/spells/stinking-cloud.md)* (DC 18), *[suggestion](../../magic/spells/suggestion.md)* (DC 18)  
2nd (7/day)—*[eagle’s splendor](../../magic/spells/eagles-splendor.md)*, *[glitterdust](../../magic/spells/glitterdust.md)* (DC 17), *[gust of wind](../../magic/spells/gust-of-wind.md)*, *[locate object](../../magic/spells/locate-object.md)*, *[see invisibility](../../magic/spells/see-invisibility.md)*  
1st (8/day)—*[alter winds](../../magic/spells/alter-winds.md)**, *[charm person](../../magic/spells/charm-person.md)* (DC 16), *[detect secret doors](../../magic/spells/detect-secret-doors.md)*, *[erase](../../magic/spells/erase.md)*, *[true strike](../../magic/spells/true-strike.md)*  
0 (at will)—*[dancing lights](../../magic/spells/dancing-lights.md)*, *[detect poison](../../magic/spells/detect-poison.md)*, *[light](../../magic/spells/light.md)*, *[mage hand](../../magic/spells/mage-hand.md)*, *[message](../../magic/spells/message.md)*, *[prestidigitation](../../magic/spells/prestidigitation.md)*, *[read magic](../../magic/spells/read-magic.md)*, *[resistance](../../magic/spells/resistance.md)*, *[touch of fatigue](../../magic/spells/touch-of-fatigue.md)*  

 * This spell is from the Pathfinder RPG Advanced Player’s Guide.  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 30, **Dex** 7, **Con** 23, **Int** 18, **Wis** 22, **Cha** 21  
 **Base Atk** +22; **CMB** +36; **CMD** 44 (48 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Critical Focus, Dazzling Display, Flyby Attack, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Multiattack, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Diplomacy), Stunning Critical, Weapon Focus (bite, claws)  
 **Skills** Appraise +29, Diplomacy +36, Fly +9, Intimidate +30, Knowledge (planes) +29, Perception +31, Sense Motive +31, Stealth +11, Survival +31, Swim +43; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Swim  
**Languages** Auran, Common, Draconic, Elven, Sylvan  
 **SQ** cloud form (22 rounds/day)  

**Special Abilities**

 **Cloud Form (Su)**  An adult or older cloud dragon can change itself into a cloudy vapor as a swift action for a number of rounds per day equal to its Hit Dice. This ability functions as *gaseous form* but the dragon’s fly speed is unchanged.  

 **Mist Vision (Su)**  A cloud dragon can see through fog, clouds, and similar obscuring effects with perfect clarity.  

  ECOLOGY

**Environment** any sky (Plane of Air)  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple  
 Cloud dragons stay out of the complicated political schemes and obsessions of other dragons (especially the chromatic dragons), preferring to live their lives freely and as the whim to travel strikes them. Exploration and viewing new lands from far above are the cloud dragon’s greatest joy, rivaled only by speaking with new creatures and gaining exotic treasures from them. They keep lairs on high mountain peaks, but are often away on journeys of discovery, returning home only when they’ve claimed a new treasure that needs to be placed in safekeeping back home.
